cases.why: This is the whole point of matching on the sender: no one-time code, no advert, no message from her family can reach a function that moves money, whatever it says. Not even a message that reads exactly like a real one.
A shortcode nobody confirmed is a stranger, however bank-shaped the body is.
«Tel100031» reduced to digits is Refah's shortcode. Reading it would let a sender that is neither built in nor confirmed overwrite her Refah balance.
From a real bank, but it names no amount and no balance, so it is not a transaction and must produce nothing rather than something at low confidence.
